plugins.name: rockstarr-infra
plugins.description: Foundation plugin every Rockstarr client install includes. Scaffolds /rockstarr-ai/, runs onboarding, generates the brand style guide, ingests the knowledge base, captures the tool stack. Owns the cross-bot approve and publish-log lifecycle and email notifications (daily approvals digest, weekly backlog alert, urgent reply-ready email). Every other Rockstarr plugin depends on this — run-onboarding is the entry point for new clients.

plugins.name: rockstarr-content
plugins.description: Rockstarr AI content plugin. Drafts researched blogs, thought-leadership, email and LinkedIn newsletters, case studies, and repurposed short-form in the client's approved voice, plus the SEO layer: keyword and cluster strategy and an impact-first site audit that feeds the content backlog. Every lane is cadence-gated in stack.md and routes through rockstarr-infra:approve. Drafting uses first-party knowledge only; third-party sources are cited inline, never paraphrased as the client's voice.

plugins.name: rockstarr-outreach-salesnav
plugins.description: Rockstarr AI LinkedIn outreach plugin for clients on Sales Navigator only — no third-party outreach tool. Supports full-sequence campaigns (connect request + three-message post-accept conversation) and connect-only campaigns. Drives Sales Nav via Chrome MCP and keeps all state in a single workbook under /rockstarr-ai/. Enforces a 20/day and 100/week connection cap. Every reply routes through rockstarr-reply for operator approval.

plugins.name: rockstarr-reply
plugins.description: Rockstarr AI channel-agnostic reply drafting for the Growth OS. Called by every rockstarr-outreach-* plugin to draft replies to inbound LinkedIn messages. Owns voice, classification, three-option non-ICP flow, stop-slop pass, and the 'send it' authorization gate. The caller owns the channel I/O. v0.2 wires the front-matter contract for rockstarr-infra v0.8 cross-bot notifications (notify-reply-ready + approvals-digest).

plugins.name: rockstarr-social
plugins.description: Rockstarr AI social plugin. Drafts short-form social posts (LinkedIn default; X and Instagram optional) in the client's approved voice, builds balanced weekly batches, and exports to the client's scheduler (Publer or GrowthAmp planner). Also owns LinkedIn polls, monthly page-follow invites, and a daily comment-check workflow with per-comment approval. Every batch flows through rockstarr-infra:approve — the bot never posts directly.

plugins.name: rockstarr-ops
plugins.description: Rockstarr AI sales-ops bot for the Growth OS. Tool-agnostic by design: every CRM, task system, meeting recorder, calendar, email platform, deliverability tool, and LinkedIn outreach tool is named in stack.md at install time. V0.1 covers daily call prep (orchestrator), Call 1 + Call 2 prep, client catch-up agendas, old-lead audits, lead reengagement, post-call transcript processing, and recurring email-deliverability tests. Drafting goes through rockstarr-reply; CRM writes go through the active rockstarr-ops-bot-<crm> variant; LinkedIn DM sends go through the active rockstarr-outreach-* variant. No baked-in framework, voice, pitch, or pricing — every behavior comes from intake-produced files (pitch.md, ops-call-framework.md, deliverability-config.md, icp-qualifications.md, style-guide.md) plus stack.md.

plugins.name: rockstarr-orchestrator
plugins.description: Rockstarr AI marketing-team orchestrator — the team lead. Talk to it; it coordinates the role functions (content, social, demand gen, RevOps) toward your marketing goals. It snapshots what already exists (the master list), captures the goals spine, gives a read-only team report, and runs named cross-role plays — on demand or an opt-in weekly schedule. It auto-runs the internal, reversible steps and stops at every audience-facing gate; humans approve publishing, outreach, and posts.
